# Windhawk 1.7.3 source

`Windhawk-1.7.3-source.zip` is the unmodified official v1.7.3 source archive:
https://github.com/ramensoftware/windhawk/archive/refs/tags/v1.7.3.zip

SHA-256: `7dcce5a390081b8eb241a4661f306e8b3e56b85f26def5aac4b36385783d855f`.

It accompanies the GPL Windhawk binaries bundled for Quick Settings integration.
License, copyright notices and build files are inside the archive. The build
script obtains binaries from the signed official v1.7.3 offline installer.
Source and upstream revision for our modified brightness extension are separately
preserved in this repository's `upstream/`, `src/`, `mods/` and `tools/` directories.
